title: Account
description: Profile, phone and sign-out.

description: Answers to common questions and the rider's support tickets.

description: A ticket thread with RideNow support.

description: Trip, wallet and support updates.

description: Past rides grouped by day with earnings.

title: Trip details
description: Earning breakdown, commission and the rating received.

title: Ratings
description: Average rating, star breakdown, top compliments and recent comments.

title: Account
description: Profile, vehicle, document status with expiry warnings, and location mode.

title: Help
description: Driver support topics and tickets.

title: Support conversation
description: A driver's ticket thread with operations.

title: Notifications
description: Payouts, account and trip updates.

description: Operations accounts only; rider and driver accounts are refused.

description: Route map, status timeline, dispatch offers, fare breakdown, ledger lines and ratings, with cancel and refund.

description: Search riders with trips, spend, rating and wallet balance.

description: Driver withdrawal requests to pay or reject.

description: Platform balance, 30-day movements, money owed to drivers and rider wallet float.

description: Rider and driver tickets by status and priority.

title: Settings
description: Operator account, device preferences, and which providers are mocks and where real ones plug in.

title: Home, online
description: Online with the position shown to dispatch; requests arrive here.

description: Fare, your earning, pickup distance, trip length, rider rating and payment, with a countdown to accept or decline.

description: The rider, pickup on the map, call, and “I've arrived”.
